text: A three-minute tour of ActivityLane. Bookings, staff, money and safeguarding in one login.
Your dashboard: income, bookings and spaces left at a glance, updating live as parents book.
Listings: every camp and club with its own cover photo, price, dates and places left.
Share a booking link or QR code for any listing, so parents can book and pay online.
Embed puts a Book now button on your own website with one line of code.
Cancellations: pick a policy per listing, with refunds back to the parent's card or wallet.
Discount codes and vouchers: percentage or fixed-amount codes with limits and expiry dates.
Memberships for parents: tiers that give wallet credit or a standing discount at checkout.
Bookings: who, what, when and whether it is paid, with waitlists and capacity handled for you.
Registers: on the day, sign children in and see medical notes and collection details.
Email campaigns: send to the right families, with every sent campaign and its open rate kept on file.
Compose from a template, choose an audience, then send now or schedule for later.
Newsfeed: post news and event updates for all your families.
Moments: share photos and highlights from the day with parents.
Log a concern or incident, with who was involved, what happened and what was done.
First aid: accident records with treatment given and who the first aider was.
Medication: parental consent, dose and storage on record, and a log of every dose given.
Task manager: hand jobs to your team with due dates and priorities, and tick them off.
Money in: parents pay into your own Stripe account, and Tax-Free Childcare and childcare vouchers are recorded against the booking by reference.
Staff schedule: build the rota by week, by area or by team member, with the wage cost worked out as you roster.
Availability: ask your team when they can work. They answer from their own portal and you roster from their replies.
Staff checks as you roster: lapsed DBS, first aid and training are flagged on the rota before anyone is put on a session.
Happy with the week? Publish the rota to your team in one click.
Payroll: tax, National Insurance and pension, payslips, and journals you can post to Xero or QuickBooks.
The Learning Centre: assign courses to roles, and every completion is filed against the staff record.
Compliance: DBS checks and certificates in one place, with reminders before anything lapses.
Messages: talk to families in one place, one to one or in groups.

Ready when you are Book a demo, or start free for 7 days. A flat monthly fee. Never a cut of your bookings. Also built in: meals, trips and consent, ratios, calendar, timetable, referrals and reviews.
